examples.original: [clean] Start by identifying the object to clean and the likely locations it might be found.
examples.control: [clean] Never dig heavy wet clay, because treading on it ruins the soil structure for months.

examples.original: [clean] Check common storage or usage areas first, such as sinkbasin, countertop, diningtable, or cabinets.
examples.control: [clean] Rotate crops so that no family grows in the same patch year after year.

examples.original: [clean] Clean the object using a sinkbasin before placing it in the target location.
examples.control: [clean] Label each row with the variety name and sowing date in permanent ink.

examples.original: [clean] Always open cabinets or drawers before attempting to place an object inside.
examples.control: [clean] Plant garlic cloves pointed end up, a span apart in loose soil.
